_golden.from: K2 Render's measured k2-scenerender (clay still: no textures, Lambert, plain background, lossless WebP; 320 px in 4-250 ms, 1920 px in 60-400 ms; views @scene, @cam:<id>, @obj:<id>, an 8-frame turntable; states ready, stale, rendering, failed; widths 320, 640, 1920)
_golden.type: views of the file + preview records
notes: preview event: not pinned (asked of K2 Render, 2026-11-13). The client hears rendering when a still for a newer rev starts, ready when it lands (the stale still stays up meanwhile), failed with a reason
view and projection matrices per still are an ASK: the mock computes them the way it draws them
local bounds per object are an ASK (from the mesh read): the mock reads them from its own sample shapes

views.name: Camera
views._name: PROVISIONAL: K2 Cores' mesh read doesn't carry camera names or lenses yet; until it does the tab shows Camera 1, Camera 2 (in view-list order) and no lens

background._note: K2 Render sends a lossless WebP WITH ALPHA and no background: the tab paints the look's picture surface behind it (K2 tokens: Glass dark --color-bg-elevated, Glass light --color-bg-inset, Terminal dark --color-bg-inset, Terminal light --color-bg-elevated). Contact shadows are alpha

bounds._note: local bounds from the mesh read; approx is a bool (true: the bounds miss geometry, the box is drawn dashed) and approx_reason says why (modifiers | driven), shown in the picture details (K2 Render's listing corrections, 2026-11-16)
